# C09 — Diaphaneity

## #0

Diaphaneity is the capacity of a determination to disclose its mediation: what appears can be read together with the position, means and conditions through which it appears. The medium's shaping role becomes visible in what it lets through. Its disappearance would remove the very relation that has become intelligible.

[C05 — Immutable Gap](C05-Immutable-Gap.md) **grounds** the enduring non-coincidence which this does not abolish. [A04 — Diaphaneity](../A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) **grounds** the positive argument. C09 retains the operation of reading in both directions: a situated self sees a world; the disclosed world also shows the situation of that self.

## #1

Perspective renders a world from a position. Its achievement includes determinate depth, proportion and a field that can be communicated. Its conditions can nevertheless disappear behind the scene it renders. Adding more detail to the scene does not necessarily reveal that disappearance.

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin.md|Gebser — The Ever-Present Origin]] **historicises** this problem through the emergence of landscape and perspectival optics. His aperspectival direction releases perspective from exclusive validity while retaining its achievement. The source relation is **Paraphrased** for the historical account and **Argued from** it for the essay's contemporary contextual continuation.

Gebserian co-presence gives this concept a second office that is not reducible to perspective metadata. **A report of experience is first a psychic fact before it is assigned a final causal or ontological explanation.** Ordinary and extraordinary, natural and reported-as-supernatural experience can therefore enter the field without being screened out because one register already knows what another is allowed to say. The experience, its symbolic articulation, its historical comparanda, its bodily or physical conditions and its metaphysical interpretation remain distinct claims. Diaphaneity makes those relations readable together; it does not collapse their warrants.

## #2

A contextual reading must be involved in what it sees. Taylor's direct [P5 — Gebser] **sources** the pressure as being with the text and subtext. Care for the situation's outcome belongs to the seeing; impartiality does not require indifference.

Its absent-Father image makes the pathology exact. An unavailable final standard remains active as a demand; a surrogate image can then occupy its office. Apparent aloofness becomes a way of ruling while disavowing participation. This is Taylor's authorial development, not a quotation from Gebser. [A24 — Usurpation of Measure](../A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) **extends** the office/standard consequence, while C09 retains the task of making the hidden position readable.

## #3

The corrected stained-glass image gives the operation a whole body. Originating white light figures Bimba; its full ordered spectrum figures QL. Differently made and positioned panes, their densities, angles, colours and lead seams figure MEF's refracting apparatus. The coloured image cast into the room is Pratibimba. Recognition reads the one light through the lawful differences of the display.

The seams retain source distinctions and translation limits. The projected image changes with sun, pane, room and viewer. Its changes disclose relations that a single fixed view concealed. The Original is not an average of images or a final picture assembled from their sum. QL belongs to the light's internal order; reducing it to the lead framework repeats the assignment explicitly corrected in the developmental quilt.

[C39 — MEF](C39-Meta-Epistemic-Framework.md) **defines** the refractive office; [A22 — World-Atlas](../A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **extends** the coordination of differing views. The image figures the operation; it does not use physical optics to prove metaphysics.

## #4

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/maroski/maroski-2025-seeing-through-solid-words/maroski-2025-seeing-through-solid-words.md#^maroski-2025-seeing-through-solid-words-q002|Maroski's transparency distinction]] **qualifies** the reading: transparency concerns the form manifestation takes. It is not another manifested object. Her companion seed/tree discussion preserves the co-presence of consciousness structures rather than a sequence which discards each predecessor.

The native first-, second- and third-person passage reaches context when their positions become jointly available. Its `180°→360°` articulation belongs to the QL theorem field, not to a claim that Gebser derived QL. [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md|Taylor — Core Theorems]] **grounds** the personed `AM/IS` and its place in the whole eightfold. Context is not a fourth pronoun or an observer outside all views.

Co-presence therefore operates across time as well as within a single context. A later structure does not erase earlier powers of image, myth, polarity or rational articulation; each can recur productively or pathologically within a present Life. [A09 — Tattvic Differential Field](../A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md) supplies a distinct Indian account of consciousness's capacity to differentiate itself into a world, while [A10 — Advent of Zero](../A10-Advent-of-Zero.md) now locates the zero/Kashmir relation in its specific Indian chronology. These are source-distinct histories whose meeting makes cross-register inquiry possible rather than making one the explanation of the other.

## #5→0

[Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-regard-refraction): The viewer’s changed relation to the pane **figures** diaphaneity through the means of seeing. Material, colour, seam and placement become readable in what appears, and another view exposes an earlier occlusion. Seeing these conditions changes how the next judgment is made; merely describing them while keeping the criterion immune would leave the whole’s return unperformed.

The [travelling-jigsaw whole](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-blue-marble-hinge) **figures** diaphaneity through a planetary picture that retains its location, time, production and exclusions in use. Its breadth ceases to decide the authority of its account in advance. The viewer becomes answerable within the disclosed relation, with exact image-asset provenance still a separate acquisition task.

The [complete window sequence](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/stained-glass-refraction/WHOLE.md#stained-glass-changing-context) **figures** the medium’s disclosed operation as sun, pane, room and viewer change together. The changed image makes the conditions of its predecessor readable; contextual transparency reaches the next judgement through that difference.

The world-parent opening gives light its directions and boundaries. Taylor's encounter makes the conditions of this disclosure visible within the differentiated field it discloses. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](../../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-world-parent-separation). The circle-costume supplies a precise case of disclosure becoming opaque to its own conditions. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](../../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-position-opposition).

For a technical account, visible output or execution logs are only a beginning. [C40 — Model Internality](C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field.md) **tests** whether source, lens, evaluator, permission and exclusion become legible within what is judged. A plausible explanation of an answer can still leave its governing standard untouched. Diaphaneity requires that what becomes visible can bear on the next judgment.

The positive psychic-fact office is realised differently across the product field. [S1 / Actuation](../products/S1-Actuation.md) concerns the experience or report as living articulation; [S4 / Workcell](../products/S4-Workcell.md) concerns the situated aperture and material resistance through which it occurs; [S5 / Quaternal Logic](../products/S5-Quaternal-Logic.md) keeps differentiated accounts in relation to their containing wholes. None of these offices decides in advance what an extraordinary report “really was.” They keep the report, its conditions and its interpretations available for a return that can refine the next act of inquiry.

[[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD|Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis]] **grounds** **Con-text-through-Diaphaneity → Regard** at evidence register3. Regard is the operation flowering from the generated relation, not a substitute name for it. [C47 — Deferential Intelligence](C47-Deferential-Intelligence.md) **extends** the resulting answerability into action and model revision. C09 **returns-to** [C08 — Context Frame](C08-Context-Context-Frame.md): the frame becomes readable through its effects and remains available for change.

**Depth Restoration:** invested seeing, absent standard/surrogate office, corrected whole stained glass, transparency as form, personed co-presence, psychic facticity and technical return are restored. The earlier lowercase diaphaneity carrier remains provenance; C09 retains the canonical identity.

**Unresolved Delta:** direct Gebser quotations still need selected-edition verification; Maroski's indexed passages are quotation-ready secondary scholarship. The P5 Father image and QL geometry remain authorial developments. Technical diaphaneity is a criterion for a working system, not a report that an implementation already satisfies it.
